At Capital One, we're building a leading information-based technology company. Still founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One is on a mission to help our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking. We measure our efforts by the success our customers enjoy and the advocacy they exhibit. We are succeeding because they are succeeding.

Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. We elevate each other and obsess about doing the right thing. new_jobs.description:
Description

The console is where most customers meet Amazon RDS, and where AWS operators keep the service healthy every hour of every day. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager in Dublin to own the end-to-end customer experience including AWS Console, and CloudFormation for RDS. This role spans both the customer-facing console and the internal operations console used to run the service. This leader will define how customers discover, configure, and manage their databases, and how AWS engineers operate one of the largest managed database fleets in the world.

This is a broad, high-impact charter. You will lead multiple teams responsible for the RDS customer experience and the next-generation internal operations console, and you will own how agentic AI is incorporated into both. That means reimagining the console from a set of forms and dashboards into an intelligent, assistive experience: one that guides customers to the right decisions, surfaces the right operational context to engineers, and takes safe, well-scoped actions on their behalf. You will set the product and technical vision, deliver a modern operator console to replace legacy tooling, and raise the bar on usability, safety, and speed across the RDS console surface.

The ideal candidate pairs strong product and customer-experience instincts with deep engineering judgment, and is excited to lead at the frontier of applying agentic AI to real operational and customer workflows. You build teams that obsess over the people using their software, whether that is a customer launching their first database or an operator responding to a live event.

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, strategy, and delivery for the RDS AWS Console experience, covering both the customer console and the internal operations console.
Lead the incorporation of agentic AI into the console: assistive guidance, contextual insights, and safe, scoped automated actions for customers and operators.
Build and deliver the next-generation internal operations console, modernizing and replacing legacy operator tooling.
Lead and grow several engineering teams; hire, develop, and retain strong managers and senior engineers.
Raise the bar on console usability, accessibility, performance, and safety across every RDS surface.
Partner with AWS Console, design, product, and RDS platform teams to deliver a coherent, best-in-class experience.
Represent console and operator strategy to senior AWS leadership and align stakeholders on long-term direction.

A day in the life

You start the day reviewing a prototype that brings an agentic assistant into the customer console, digging into how it stays safe, explainable, and trustworthy. You then meet with the operations console team on the plan to retire a legacy internal tool, and work through how operators will adopt the new experience during live events. In the afternoon you align with AWS Console and design partners on shared patterns, review your org's hiring pipeline with a manager, and spend time with a senior engineer shaping the multi-year architecture for an AI-native console platform.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in engineering
Experience in engineering team management
Experience in planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software
Experience partnering with product or program management teams
Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred Qualifications

Experience partnering with product and program management teams
Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
